links.outcome: Reduction in harmful agent actions when a pre-execution verification toolkit is used
links.effect: TrustBench reduced harmful actions by 87% across multiple agentic tasks. Domain-specific plugins gave 35% greater harm reduction than generic verification.
links.quote: Across multiple agentic tasks, TrustBench reduced harmful actions by 87%.

unlisted_practices: Real-time pre-execution trust verification toolkit that agents invoke after formulating an action but before executing it
Domain-specific safety plugins (healthcare, finance, technical) versus generic verification
LLM-as-a-Judge trust benchmarking across multiple dimensions

screen.practice: Pre-execution action verification with domain-specific safety plugins
screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks TrustBench, an action-verification guardrail toolkit invoked before agents execute actions (including domain-specific plugins for healthcare), evaluating harm reduction.
